limitations: jCodeMunch index unavailable in this environment (dispatcher decision recorded in revision 8ca4227); consumer analysis used two independently-shaped grep passes plus direct file reads: (1) repo-wide word-boundary identifier scan over 790 exported symbols in src/core/shared and public/assets/js, (2) import-statement/module-reference enumeration, (3) in-file occurrence counts and direct reads of each claimed-dead symbol.
Script reference scan covered extensions json/md/toml/yml/yaml/ts/mjs/rs/html/sh/py/conf; references in other file formats were not scanned.

CSS class analysis is word-boundary and case-sensitive; dynamic class composition was manually re-checked via template-literal/concat/map patterns (chart__dot--*, att-seg__btn--*, wd-mark--*, wd-opschip--*, cb-status--*, hue-1..8, is-skipped, lb-rank--*, sn-cell--* classified as used). One false negative (.phone) caused by identifier collision with a JS local variable was caught and reclassified as dead.

Zod schema atoms in src/core/shared/schemas.ts that are consumed by internal composition inside the same file (e.g. IsoDateTimeSchema, NationalIdSchema, SlotAlignedTimeSchema) were classified as used, not dead; only atoms with zero internal and zero external references are reported.
Migrations were treated as immutable append-only history and were not audited for removal; vendored third-party assets and generated bundles are outside hand-maintained scope.
No project code was executed, no build was run, no network access was used; all evidence is static.

findings.title: فرضیهٔ «helperهای format.js بدون مصرف‌نده‌اند» رد شد — همهٔ exportها مصرف دارند

identity.assertion: ۳۰ export فایل format.js همگی بیرونی یا درونی مصرف می‌شوند؛ فایل با ۵۷ فایل مصرف‌نده پرمصرف‌ترین helper کلاینت است

evidence.detail: حتی PLACEHOLDER_NID_PREFIX که هیچ مصرف بیرونی ندارد، در isPlaceholderNid (سطر 17-18) به‌صورت درونی مصرف می‌شود.
۵۷ فایل در public/assets/js با import از format.js (اسکن module-reference)؛ اسکن شناسهٔ ۳۰ export هیچ zero-external دیگری جز PLACEHOLDER_NID_PREFIX نشان نداد که درونی‌مصرف است.
